Salaries will now be paid on the 25th of each month instead of the last working day. Please note that if the 25th falls on a weekend, your payment will arrive on the Friday before.

Please be aware that overtime from the final week of each month is paid the following month.

Best regards,
Human Resources Department

Office Management

**Quiet Zone Pilot Update**

Hello everyone,

Since 2 September, our second floor has operated as a quiet zone where phone calls are not permitted. We wanted to share some early findings from this pilot.

In the October member survey, 58 of 97 respondents reported being able to focus better in the quiet zone. However, noise complaints received by the front desk have remained steady at approximately 12 per month.

Elif Demir, our community manager, notes that these two data points suggest mixed results. While many members feel the quiet zone supports their concentration, the continued volume of complaints indicates uncertainty about its overall effectiveness.

We will continue to monitor feedback and evaluate whether to extend or adjust the quiet zone policy. Thank you for your patience and participation as we work to improve our shared workspace.

Best regards,
Foundry Coworking Team
